references.text: Hobab, son of Reuel, Moses' father-in-law, is mentioned here as a Midianite, which shows the connection to the Kenite family.
Cain is mentioned as an ancestor, and the Kenites (Heb. קֵינִי) have their name linked to him.
Reuel is mentioned as Moses' father-in-law, who is the father of Hobab.
Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, was a priest in Midian and is connected to the Kenite lineage.
Balaam's prophecy about the Kenites, which shows their connection to Israel's history.
The Kenites, descendants of Moses' father-in-law, came up from the City of Palms together with the tribe of Judah.
Jael, the wife of Heber, is mentioned in connection with Sisera, as a continuation of this account.
Kedesh in Naphtali is mentioned as one of the cities of refuge, the same place referred to in this text.
